title: Neuroimmune Responses to Exercise in Chronic Back Pain
official: Neuroimmune Responses to Physical Exercise Training in Chronic Primary Low Back Pain
summary: The goal of this mechanistic clinical trial is to learn how physical exercise affects the body and brain in people with chronic low back pain. The study will examine whether a 12-week online exercise program changes these measures compared with a waitlist group. Researchers will also study immune activity and brain function in people with chronic low back pain and compare them with healthy participants. Participants will complete questionnaires, provide blood samples, and undergo brain imaging scans.
